notes.id: Disebut "Sekolah Montesiana"; uang pangkal "sekitar Rp50 jutaan", SPP tidak disebut. Berlokasi di Sungai Jodoh, Batu Ampar. Data TA 2024/2025 dari survei pribadi orang tua (unggahan Instagram) yang dikutip media; uang pangkal umumnya sudah termasuk seragam, buku, dan fasilitas. Konfirmasi ke sekolah.
notes.en: Listed as "Sekolah Montesiana"; entry fee "around Rp50 million", tuition not given. Located in Sungai Jodoh, Batu Ampar. 2024/2025 figures from a parent's own survey (Instagram post) quoted by the outlet; entry fees usually include uniforms, books and facilities. Confirm with the school.
